rules: Never derive a city construction rate solely from GDP or CPI.
National indices adjust verified local quotes; they do not replace local quotes.
Imported specialist mosque products must expose landed-cost assumptions.
Volunteer/in-kind work appears as both market-value contribution and cash-cost reduction so total project value remains visible.
Show P10/P50/P90 or low/base/high where enough uncertainty data exists.
